name: sidechat-monitor
description: Background monitor: polls sidechat for pending @-mentions and wakes the Claude Code REPL. As of 0.1.1 (sidechat 2.6.28+) it also tmux-injects /mention-check directly, absorbing the role sc-webhook-server.py used to play so bots no longer need a sibling sidechat-webhook.service for idle-REPL wake.
